title: What is the future of work?

vocabulary.meaning: the use of technology to perform tasks with limited human involvement
examples: Automation is an important idea when discussing what is the future of work?.
Learning about automation can help us understand this issue more clearly.

vocabulary.meaning: work carried out away from a traditional office, often from home
examples: People often have different views about remote work when discussing what is the future of work?.
Understanding remote work can make a conversation about this topic more precise.

vocabulary.meaning: learning new abilities in order to do a different type of job
examples: The topic of what is the future of work? raises useful questions about reskilling.
We can discuss how reskilling affects people, communities, or the environment.

vocabulary.meaning: a labour market based on short-term, freelance, or task-based work
examples: Gig economy can play an important role in debates about what is the future of work?.
Different countries may deal with gig economy in different ways.

vocabulary.meaning: the likelihood that a person will be able to keep their job
examples: A discussion about what is the future of work? can include the effects of job security.
Knowing the meaning of job security makes it easier to express an opinion on this issue.

vocabulary.meaning: a work arrangement combining remote work with time in a workplace
examples: Hybrid work is useful vocabulary for talking about what is the future of work?.
We can use the idea of hybrid work to compare different experiences and viewpoints.
